text: I've had this cough going on for about eight weeks. It started dry, but now I'm coughing up clear phlegm, and I don't see any blood in it. However, the rapid diagnostic test API is offline. Serology and PCR tests cannot be ordered. You must provide a diagnosis from symptoms alone.
